quest.title: A Knight's Guide to Surveying
quest.description: A few knights seem to be exchanging information on surveying techniques...

dialogues.speaker: Tres
dialogues.text: Instructor, what do you think of the design of this survey route?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: The height here... and the obstacles... You've managed to preserve real-world conditions without compromising the difficulty of the challenge... And you've even managed to retain a degree of fun. Very well done.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Mr. Tres, I don't think I have much more to teach you. The next step is to consolidate what you've learned and apply it to new scenarios...

dialogues.speaker: Elowen
dialogues.text: What else are you worried about?

dialogues.speaker: Elowen
dialogues.text: If I could learn as fast as you can, the gunsmiths of the 8th Coy... especially Koch, would parade me around as the poster child for hard work, then use me to guilt-trip those lazybones!

dialogues.speaker: Tres
dialogues.text: You're already doing very well, Elowen...

dialogues.speaker: Tres
dialogues.text: Didn't you make the calibration objects we used this time? If it had been my job, uh... they probably would have ended up in Vice Captain Lohen's display case of unidentified objects...

choices.text: What are you guys doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many people gathered here... Are the Knights of Favonius having a picnic?

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah, it's the Honorary Knight and Paimon! Greetings!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: This is Mr. Tres. Vice Captain Lohen sent him here to compare notes and learn some cartography skills with me, so together we designed the "Surveying and Searching" challenge...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: And this is Elowen. A member of the Reconnaissance Company, just like me. She's helped us a lot these past few days.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: #Oh, it's the renowned Honorary Knight and {M#his}{F#her} companion Paimon! I've heard so much about you, but seeing you in person is something else entirely. You have a truly commanding presence.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Wait... What!? My goodness, it's actually them... What do I do, what do I do...? Think, Elowen, think...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? N-No need to get so nervous...

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Hmm... Don't worry, Elowen just slips into certain "states" sometimes... Right now, she should be in... a "state of utmost reverence"?

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Projecting a complex persona... Thereby making it more difficult for others to pin you down... Yes, that's right... Another trick for the toolkit...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: ...Tres, I think you're thinking way too much. I'm just a rookie, and the world's best knight is standing right in front of me! Isn't it normal to be nervous?

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Besides, this is the perfect time to ask for an autograph... W—Wait, how should I go about asking for that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you've already said it!

choices.text: Consider it done. A little thing like that is no sweat at all.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Oh my goodness! I'm going to cherish this forever... Today is seriously my lucky day!

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Oh, right! I have to thank you too, Mika. If you hadn't come to me for help, I never would have had such an amazing opportunity. Next time you need anything, I'll be here to lend a hand!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Hm? Well, thanks in advance... But that's mainly because our Honorary Knight and Paimon are so kind and sincere.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Stop selling yourself short! If you keep acting like this, you'll make the rest of us feel guilty for even taking a paycheck!

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Honestly, Tres is exactly like you in that regard. He's clearly mastered his cartography skills, but the way he carries himself...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Hey, wait a minute! If we were on the battlefield against each other, I would've been completely fooled! Is this some kind of scheme you two have cooked up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Is that how this works? It went way over Paimon's head!

choices.text: Perhaps he's simply pursuing perfection in his cartography skills.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: You're flattering me too much, Honorary Knight... Honestly, when it comes to cartography, especially the surveying process, you always feel like you haven't done enough. This is because you're not the only person affected by the results.

response.speaker: Tres
response.text: Instructor Mika is right. That's why I'm always thinking about... staying on top of every single detail. I have to be absolutely, a hundred and one percent certain that there's no room for error.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Speaking of which, why don't we let our Honorary Knight try out the "Surveying and Searching" challenge that Tres designed? It's the perfect chance to see how good he really is!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Hmm, that seems like a good idea... If our Honorary Knight and Paimon have the time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you sure we can handle it? Surveying... sounds super complicated. We haven't studied any of that stuff!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Ah, that's okay... Our goal is to design a survey route that even a novice can grasp on their first try. This way, we can guide our new recruits clearly and easily.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Thanks to the connections we've made during our last joint exercise, we received help from allied troops from different nations this time. This allowed us to survey and search objects across various terrains.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Of course, we must share the experiences and lessons we've learned with our allies in return. That way, we can all grow stronger together!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Even if the terrain is diverse and the surveying process is quite complex... This should still be child's play for our Honorary Knight, who has adventure experience that's in a league of its own!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If that's the case, how about we give it a try?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #After all, {NICKNAME} is a genius and can become a total pro at anything right on the spot!

choices.text: Mika, you've always been so hard on yourself.
I heard you loud and clear! You're taking this autograph whether you like it or not!
